subject: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors
messages:
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: sara@harborwave.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors

Hi Sara —

We tried to invite your new AP user (j.taylor@harborwave.com) into the Coupa supplier portal this morning and it looks like the invite never completed. Our portal shows the invite in a queued state for ~40 minutes and your team reports the recipient never received the email. Attaching the portal trace and a screenshot of the queued state.

Quick details:
- External email: j.taylor@harborwave.com
- Invite attempted from Redwood portal (eu-prod) at 16:02 UTC
- Portal trace shows repeated 429s from coupa-invite-worker

Can you confirm if HarborWave is seeing any inbound blocks or if this is on our side? If it's a transient capacity/burst issue we can retry — just want a target ETA so the PO can be processed today.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invite_error_screenshot.png, portal_request_trace.log
From: coupa-support@coupa.com <coupa-support@coupa.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the debug info. We see a short-lived surge on the invite service in eu-prod around 16:00 UTC which triggered backpressure and temporary 429s. The platform auto-queued a subset of requests to avoid overload; queued items should be processed within 15–30 minutes normally but during the surge some queues extended.

Can you send the full request-id from the portal trace (X-Request-Id header) and the timestamp of the invite attempt? Also, if you have a screenshot of the invite modal with the error code that would help.

We're marking this as priority and will patch the invite worker to add an exponential retry sooner.

Best,
Coupa Support
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: coupa-support@coupa.com, sara@harborwave.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors

Thanks — request id is req_0a3f9c2f. Full portal trace attached (portal_request_trace.log). Timestamp was 2026-07-25T16:02:19Z.

Rafael / Laura — looping you in because this is blocking HarborWave's PO acceptance and they asked for manual activation if the queue doesn't clear. Rafael, can we do a temporary manual activation for j.taylor@harborwave.com (tenant ID: hw-9872) so the supplier can submit invoices?

Sara — would appreciate any ETA on when the queued items will flush or a manual activation option from HarborWave if needed.

Ben
From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 25 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors

> Rafael / Laura — looping you in because this is blocking HarborWave's PO acceptance and they asked for manual activation if the queue doesn't clear. Rafael, can we do a temporary manual activation for j.taylor@harborwave.com (tenant ID: hw-9872) so the supplier can submit invoices?

I can do a one-off activation from the admin console but need the following before I proceed:
- confirmation that this is the exact email to activate (j.taylor@harborwave.com)
- the supplier profile id (if available) or the TAXID on file for matching (HarborWave often uses multiple vendor profiles)
- approval to bypass the invite workflow (this will leave an audit note)

If you authorize, I'll activate and then submit a support request to Coupa to increase the invite worker concurrency for tenant hw-9872 for the next 24 hours.

Rafael
Senior Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
From: sara@harborwave.com <sara@harborwave.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, coupa-support@coupa.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors

Hi Ben / Rafael —

Confirmed: please activate j.taylor@harborwave.com (profile taxid: 12-3456789). We have a PO that needs acceptance today so manual activation is fine.

Coupa — thanks for the explanation. If you can document the surge window and ETA for full resolution that helps our audit trail. We saw the same 429s on inbound webhooks earlier; the incident link you shared looks related.

Sara Patel
AP Manager
HarborWave Logistics
From: rafael_mendes <rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: sara@harborwave.com, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier portal: invite stuck in queue / rate-limit errors

Hi Sara —

Manual activation completed at 2026-07-27T21:05:13Z for j.taylor@harborwave.com (audit note: admin-activation bypassing standard invite queue; initiated by rafael_mendes at customer request). Supplier profile matched by TAXID 12-3456789 and tenant hw-9872.

Coupa responded that their team has applied a temporary concurrency bump for hw-9872, and the queued invites processed overnight. They recommend we monitor for another 24 hours and then revert to standard limits.

Ben — PO is now live and HarborWave confirmed invoice submission. Closing the loop; I'll follow up in case any residual duplicates show up in the portal.

Thanks,
Rafael
